change_policy.allowed_changes: new Stage 0.4E harnesses and tests that do not alter frozen semantics

rules: every internal reference resolves to exactly one local declaration or explicit import
unknown and ambiguous internal references are compile errors
cross-package access requires an explicitly exported symbol
foreign and dynamic boundaries are explicit and never Exact internal bindings
effectful members require a typed capability value
capabilities cannot be synthesized or widened implicitly
ambient authority is unavailable inside the closed frontend
capability escalation blocks before materialization
task effects are an explicit closed set
every effect call is a subset of its caller declared effects
effect handlers are explicit evaluator inputs
effect widening is a public contract change
explicit ChangeIR provenance may preserve SymbolId
every semantic content change creates a new RevisionId
external textual edits do not inherit SymbolId automatically
identity target collisions are rejected
package interface revisions hash only exported contracts
package implementation revisions hash all semantic declarations
private implementation edits do not invalidate downstream packages
public contract changes invalidate exact importing packages only
record enum newtype and capability types are nominal
function and task arguments and returns are checked exactly
enum matches are exhaustive and contain no duplicate arms
pure functions have an empty effect set
